scope: Desktop/WebUI coexistence and evidence-based read/parse performance analysis; Ark_emulator excluded.

delivery.git: Changes copied to primary local working tree; no commit, push or GitHub action.

behavior_changes: Desktop button opens WebUI without hiding desktop, disabling native rendering or closing native detail dialogs.
Web button only shows/activates desktop. Every page can keep its private clock/modules streams; no exclusive owner or standby handshake.
Core readers, source session, policy and public WS remain shared. Opening a frontend does not start another core sampling worker.
Web selected-detail demand is per page and merged with existing shared asynchronous WS detail demand. Desktop target setters are never overwritten by a web drawer.
Web selected-detail nominal demand preserves the former 60 Hz setting. Actual completion depends on work and guards; no 60 Hz result is claimed.
Web details expire after ten seconds without page heartbeat and cannot transfer across source/battle session identities.

pipeline.work: Explicit MuMu selection, adbd root check, package/PID, process birth and maps. ADB is setup/transport plumbing, not one shell call per field.
Device-side region/class/object scans locate BattleController, handbook, native Unity Time and BattleInOut. Accept roots by live class/ownership/layout checks.
Clock/lifecycle, deployment journal and RNG keep separate ownership/rates. Deployment defaults to 0.3-second polling. These are not components of one atomic enemy frame.
Bind immutable policy generation, execute resident core plan plus separately guarded optional plan; parse enemy, characters, pause/scale, map and waves.

Produce all enabled field states/source frames, enforce process/battle identity, complete-frame and path guards; reject mismatches with bounded retries. Discovery values cannot be promoted to current detail evidence.
Latest-only worker buffer wakes Qt. Qt rechecks generation/pathing, updates history and battle cache, then publishes canonical runtime/global topics.

Whitelist/sanitize, build field masks and collect/publish projections, detach accepted values from mutable producer data, commit by session/generation/ticket. Public WS sends interested topics at subscription rates.

Desktop mutates Qt tables. Local web copies changed accepted topics, formats columns, decorates requested details and serializes latest SSE slots. Browser merges latest values and renders via requestAnimationFrame; clock is separate.

measurement_method.stage: 5-10, paused; six active enemies, 73 total roster entries, two operators; F461 in timed profiles, F466 in subsequent UI QA.
measurement_method.reader: 20 warmup rounds, then 80 timed accepted captures per precision setting. Separate 30-round cProfile and 20-round bounded read-accounting probes.
measurement_method.presentation: Real accepted paused snapshot replay: 10 warmup + 60 timed rounds for desktop and desktop+web, offscreen Qt/event processing. No extra device IO or browser/GPU timing in these measurements.
measurement_method.cprofile: Use for call counts and ranking. Its instrumentation inflates timings; do not combine cProfile times with unprofiled medians.
measurement_method.comparison: Recorded local main baseline compared with coexistence implementation under the same paused replay method. This is an intentional presentation behavior change, not a claimed reader optimization.
measurement_method.limits: A paused scene cannot prove running-only unique-frame rate, retry behavior during moving scenes, browser paint cost or universal 60 Hz.

bottlenecks.area: Canonical snapshot publication and projection on the Qt/Python path
bottlenecks.evidence: Shared replay median publish_runtime 12.48 ms + publish_global 3.41 ms. cProfile shows about 1.08 million recursive _safe calls across 15 replay frames, plus _mask_unavailable/_project_topic/_public.
bottlenecks.implication: The dominant downstream Python work occurs before interested-client delivery, including with public WS disabled. It competes with parsing for the GIL.
bottlenecks.next: Compile/cache full-registry policy/path plans by immutable policy generation; retain one immutable sanitized canonical batch and cache equivalent consumer projections by source revision, session, generation and layer. Preserve mutation isolation and pointer redaction.

bottlenecks.area: Local web projection, formatting and serialization
bottlenecks.evidence: Shared replay median webui_refresh 9.51 ms; desktop+web downstream total 27.94 ms versus desktop-only 15.82 ms. LatestStream uses standard json.dumps even though public WS supports orjson.
bottlenecks.next: Separate raw topic/evidence changes from reusable presentation strings; reuse static/unchanged formatting and encode accepted immutable topics once. Verify exact JSON/value semantics before changing encoder.

bottlenecks.area: Per-entity field evidence stamping and repeated policy lookups
bottlenecks.evidence: Reader cProfile: _stamp_fields called 2190 times over 30 frames (73 roster entries/frame), collection_record 151290 times, _collect about 287460 times. Most are pending roster entities as well as active units.
bottlenecks.next: Precompile complete domain field/dependency checks per policy generation and reduce repeated string/thread-local/getattr work. Continue emitting all enabled roster and field evidence; do not filter to only visible or active rows.

bottlenecks.evidence: Stable capture uses three counted network batches, around 700+ memory operations, not hundreds of ADB shell round trips. Median IO is about 3.1-3.3 ms, p95 around 46 ms in these samples.
bottlenecks.next: Measure scheduler/socket/device tails with isolated probes before attributing delay to ADB bandwidth, TCP delayed ACK, storage or another specific cause. No such root cause is proven here.
Improve validated process-scoped class indexes/cache reuse and share equivalent cold scans. Never reuse unvalidated objects across process or battle ownership changes.

presentation_baseline.method: Replay real accepted paused snapshot; offscreen Qt mutations/event processing; browser paint and device IO excluded.

presentation_shared.method: Replay real accepted paused snapshot; offscreen Qt mutations/event processing; browser paint and device IO excluded.

validation.warnings: Two existing RNG probe return-value warnings.
validation.frontend_build: Passed via standard dual-package build script.
validation.ui: Desktop Qt visibility/update flags stay true, two browsers keep two clock and two module streams, same reader/poll object; show-desktop causes no standby navigation.
validation.native_protocol: 21-case test included in Python suite on explicit MuMu.
